title: Flow Language Vertical Slice
description: End-to-end vertical slice for flow procedural language: neural engine (Dictionary/Neuron/Evaluator), math module, DAG UI crate, flow core wasm, react renderer, and play app with slider->add->preview default fixture.
summary:
Delivered end-to-end flow language vertical slice: neural engine dictionary evaluation, math.add module, DAG IO layout crate, flow_core WASM session (load/evaluate/render), React FlowCanvas with slider+preview overlay, and flow play harness wired into framework playground.

Fixed runtime blockers:
- Added `flow` to UiRenderer switch and renderPlaygroundHostSurface fallback so window bodies no longer show "Unsupported UiNode".
- Fixed React infinite update loop: stabilized onPreviewText via ref in FlowCanvas, useCallback in FlowPlayPaneSurfaceHost, and skip controller emit when preview text unchanged.

Validated: cargo tests (flow_core, neural_engine, math, dag), wasm build, flow/play vitest, browser at :6017 shows playground shell, DAG canvas, slider default 3.0, preview "3", no Unsupported UiNode.
